attributes.content:
**EL-RSP-1.3 Front lamp reaction 10 to 20 ms**

FLCM_Lighting shall change Lamp_FrontLeftTurn and Lamp_FrontRightTurn no earlier than 10 ms and no later than 20 ms after receiving a TurnLightControl frame that changes the corresponding request.

description: Obligation of FLCM_Lighting as FrontLighting in ExteriorLightingDesign (EL-RSP-1.3).
Supplier commitment (lamp driver input filter plus LED rise time). Status accepted: there is no measurement in this repository; the analysis uses the committed window as an input.
